trans.en: In the Name of Allah, the most Gracious, the most Merciful.
trans.rurdu: (Shuru karta hu) Allah ke naam se Jo bada maher-baan nehaayat rahem karne waala hai.
trans.urdu: اللہ کے نام سے (شروع کرتا ہوں) جو بڑا مہربا ن نہایت رحم کرنے والا ہے۔

arabic.text: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلهِ شَفْعًا وَ وَتْرًا فِي الشَّفْعِ وَالْوَتْرِ مِنْ هٰذِهِ اللَّيَالِي الْمُبَارَكَاتِ وَعَلٰى مَا مَنَحَنِيْ وَاَعْطَانِيْ فِيْهِنَّ مِنَ الْخَيْرَاتِ وَتَصَدَّقَ بِهٖ عَلَيَّ وَ وَهَبَهٗ لِيْ مِنَ الْبَاقِيَاتِ الصَّالِحَاتِ الَّذِيْ صَوَّمَنِيْ لِيَاجُرَنِيْ وَفَطَرَنِيْ عَلٰى مَا رَزَقَنِيْ فَكُلٌّ مِنْ عِنْدِهٖ وَبِمِنَّتِهٖ وَبِحُسْنِ اخْتِيَارِهٖ وَنَظَرِهٖ لِعَبِيْدِهٖ۔

lines.rarabic: AL-HAMDO LIL-LAAHE SHAF-A’N WA WATRAN FISH-SHAF-E’ WAL-WATRE MIN HAAZE-HIL LAYAA-LIL MOBAA-RAKAA-TE WA A’LAA MAA MANA-HANEE WA A’TAA-NEE FEE-HINNA MINAL KHAI-RAATE WA TASAD-DAQA BEHI A’LAIY-YA WA WAHABA-HU LEE MINAL BAAQE-YAATIS SAALE-HAATIL LAZEE SAWWA-MANEE LE-YAA-JORA-NEE WA FATARA-NEE A’LAA MAA RAZAQ-NEE FA-QULLOON MIN I’N-DEHI WA BE-MIN-NATE-HI WA BE-HUS-NIKH TE-YAARE-HI WA NAZARE-HI LE-A’BEEDE-HI.

trans.en: Praise be to God evenly and oddly in the even and odd nights of these blessed nights for all the good things that He favored and bestowed upon me on them plus the good things that remain for me which He donated to me in charity. He made me fast and rewarded me for it, and He fed me with the sustenance He provided for me to break my fast with. This was all from Him due to His Favor due to His Kind Choice and attention to His Servants!
trans.urdu: انشاء اللہ ترجمہ جلد آرہا ہے

arabic.text: سُبْحَانَهٗ سَيِّدًا اَخَذَ بِيَدِيْ مِنَ الْوَرَطَاتِ وَمَحَّصَ عَنِّي الْخَطِيْئَاتِ وَكَفَانِي الْمُهِمَّاتِ وَاَغْنَانِيْ عَنِ الْمَخْلُوْقِيْنَ وَلَمْ يَجْعَلْ رِزْقِيْ اِلَى الْمَرْزُوْقِيْنَ‌ وَشَهَرَ ذِكْرِيْ فِي الْعَالَمِيْنَ وَجَعَلَ اسْمِيْ فِي الْمَذْكُوْرِيْنَ وَلَمْ يُشْقِنِيْ بِعُجْبٍ۔

lines.rarabic: SUBHAA-NAHU SAIYYEDAN A-KHAZA BE-YADEE MINAL WARA-TAATE WA MAH-HASA A’NNIL KHATEE-ATE WA KAFAA-NIL MOHIM-MAATE WA AGH-NAA NEE A’NIL MAKH-LOO-QEENA WA LAM YAJ-A’L RIZQEE ILAL MARZOO-QEENA WA SHAHARA ZIKREE FIL A’A-LAMEENA WA JA-A’LAS MEE FIL MAZKOO-REENA WA LAM YUSH-QENEE BE-U’J-BIN.

trans.en: Glory be to Him the Master who took my hand and saved me from the disastrous situations! He wiped off my wrongdoings and took care of my important needs. He made us needless of the creatures and did not let my provisions be in the hands of those who are themselves provided for. He made me reputable in the world, and recorded my name amongst those who are mentioned. He did not make me suffer from haughtiness that would lower my rank, and did not make me suffer from the darkness of His Wrath and Chastisements!

arabic.text: يَحُطُّنِيْ عَنْ دَرَجَاتٍ رَفِيْعَةٍ فَيُهْوِيْ بِيْ اِلٰى ظُلَمِ غَضَبِهٖ وَنِقْمَتِهٖ وَلَا اَبْلَانِيْ بِاسْتِحْلَالٍ يَنْزِعُ عَنِّيْ مَلَابِسَ رَحْمَتِهٖ وَيُعَوِّضُنِيْ لِبُؤْسِ الذُّلِّ مِنْ سَخَطِهٖ اِيَّاهُ اَشْكُرُ وَلَهٗ اَعْبُدُ وَمِنْهُ اَرْجُو التَّمَامَ وَ الْمَزِيْدَ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ اِلَّا بِاللهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيْمِ وَصَلَّى اللهُ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ النَّبِيِّ وَآلِهٖ وَسَلَّمَ تَسْلِيْمًا۔

lines.rarabic: YA-HUTTO-NEE A’N DARA-JAATIN RAFEE-A’TIN FA-YOHWEE BEE ILAA ZOLAME GHAZA-BEHI WA NIQ-MATE-HI WA LAA ABLAA-NEE BISTEH-LAALIN YANZE-O’ A’NNEE MALAA-BESA RAHMATE-HI WA YO-A’WWE-ZONEE LE-BO-SIZ-ZOLLE MIN SA-KHATE-HI IYYAA-HO ASH-KORO WA LAHU A’BODO WA MINHO ARJUT TA-MAAMA WAL-MAZEEDA WA LAA HAWLA WA LAA QUWWATA ILLAA BILLAA-HIL A’LIYYIL A’ZEEME WA SALLAL LAAHO A’LAA MOHAMMADIN NABIYYE WA AALE-HI WA SALLAMA TASLEE-MAN.

trans.en: He did not make me suffer from considering what is forbidden to be legitimate that could strip off the robes of His Mercy from me and wear the robes of His Wrath instead! I thank Him alone and I worship Him only! I have hopes of increase and perfection from Him! There is no change nor any strength except by God the Sublime, the Supreme and may God bestow blessings on the Prophet Muhammad (s.a.w.a) and his Progeny (a.s) and may His peace be on them plentifully.

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAHUMMA SWALLE ALAA MUHAMMADIW WA AALE MUHAMMADIN

trans.en: Allah’s (s.w.t) choicest blessings be upon Mohammed and his holy progeny.
trans.rurdu: Parwardigaar Tu rehmat naazil farma Hazrat Muhammad (s.a.w.a) aur unki Aal (a.s) par.
trans.urdu: اے معبود! رحمت نازل فرما حضرت محمدؐ اور انکی آل ؑپر۔
